correctness.rationale: Separation gives G_alpha(y_alpha(t))=C alpha t. The inequality u/(1+u) <=1-exp(-u)<=u implies L(y)<=G_alpha(y)<=L(y)+alpha y for all y in [0,1). The normalized difference is an exponentially weighted tail of q(alpha x)=1/(1-e^{-alpha x})-1/(alpha x), bounded by 1 and converging pointwise to 1/2; dominated convergence of the full L1 error proves the uniform y/2 correction, including continuous extension to y=1. Monotone inversion proves p<1 collapse, p=1 compact-uniform critical profile and p>1 saturation only for tau>0. On tau0<=tau<=T, the mean-value theorem with L'(y)=1/(-log y) yields -alpha Y(-log Y)/2 + o(alpha). No finite numerical test is used to infer any infinite assertion.
